cases.question: Which two roles did Shea hold during the Apollo program?
cases.answer: Shea held two roles during the Apollo program: (1) She was a mission scientist for the Apollo 8, 10, 12, 14, and 17 missions, responsible for analyzing and interpreting scientific data gathered during each mission; and (2) She served as the backup command module pilot for the Apollo 14 mission, meaning she was prepared to take on that role in case the primary pilot was unable to fly.
